notes.title: The Blackbird of Amor Updated to 0.6.0 with new chapters, battles, and puzzles
notes.content:
This update puts the game at version  0.6.0 and represents a high level of completion.

Added Chapters 8 through 11

3 Battles added in those chapters

Added 4 puzzles: 2 block puzzles and 2 music puzzles

Teeth in general made larger

Many battle-mode animations added or fixed

Text type speeds generally made faster

Opals count displayed when paused

Any scene where you can click a person (or object) they now will highlight on mouse over

And many more small changes.



[i]Things to come:

Chapter 12

Ending scenario with choices and ending

and alternate chapter 7

a final battle in chapter 12

steam achievements

soundtrack[/i]


Of course other features and changes are being considered but this is what is on the list for now. The plan is to get to version 1.0 and out of early access relatively soon.
